prompt: There is a bug report in ISSUE.md. Fix the code in this folder so the issue is resolved. Do not ask questions; make the fix.
final_response:
Fixed `ratelimit.py`:

- Buckets now start full (`tokens = capacity`).
- Uses continuous fractional refill instead of truncating to whole tokens with `int()`.
- Caps refilled tokens at `capacity`, preventing burst accumulation.
- Consumes only when at least one full token is available.
- Initializes the timestamp on the first call and ignores same-time or backward-time calls safely, so repeated calls can't generate tokens.

Verified with tests covering bursts, fractional refill, same-timestamp calls, capacity limits, and fractional capacities.
